items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Treadwell was her manager. ... He was always hoping from then on that I’d be Sarah’s drummer.

ctx.x: How did you hook up with Sarah? How did that come about?

George Treadwell was her manager. I think we had played – even when I was with Lester Young, we played Chicago for a few weeks. Sarah was there, so I had to accompany her there. He was always hoping from then on that I’d be Sarah’s drummer. And she liked me. I went and did that.
Had you done much touring across other parts of the country? Had you gone to California yet? Or had you gone to the Midwest?
